capabilities: render FEN positions as SVG chessboards via a chessboard code block
render PGN games and select a specific ply to display
annotate diagrams with arrows, highlights, shapes and move icons
enable interactive PGN navigation with prev/next buttons and a move list
customize board and piece colors and allow non-standard positions
disambiguation: Not a chess game or analysis tool; it only renders board diagrams, with optional interactive navigation for PGN games.
extras: PGN support is experimental and its syntax may change; annotation syntax is beta; bundled SVG pieces are CC BY-SA 3.0 by jurgenwesterhof (adapted from Cburnett).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize chess positions or games written in FEN or PGN notation inside notes.

relations.evidence: If you want a more fully featured interactive chess plugin, I recommend Chesser.

summary: Chess diagram renderer that draws FEN positions and PGN games as static SVG chessboards in the note preview.
